Jay, saw FloQast leaning into the Accounting Transformation Platform with the RSM and Trovata alliances.

As the platform footprint grows, the GTM team usually has more in-market accounts in play than it can personally cover before they cool. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for FloQast off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
